preconditions.description: The number of vertices V must be between 1 and 10,000.
The adjacency list must have exactly V elements.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < V for i in range(V))
preconditions.description: All vertices must be indexed from 0 to V-1.

postconditions.description: The output must be a sorted list of articulation points or -1 if none exist.

postconditions.expression: any(isinstance(x, int) for x in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output must contain integers representing the articulation points.
